reviews.text: The puppies are far too young to be sold and should still be with their mother. They are clearly being kept in terrible conditions, confined to tiny cages. This shop should be shut down immediately and permanently.

They recommend all sorts of options, saying it's better for the cat, but most of them are unnecessary, so it's better to research and decide for yourself. The sets have way too many unnecessary items.

Other than that, it's a very good store.

On this busy Saturday afternoon with many customers, there's one male employee who's wasting time in the middle of the road, having a long conversation with an employee from the pet shop across the street about something completely unrelated to work. There were lots of customers today.

There's never anyone in the sales area, so I have to go down to the first floor to call someone. It's a hassle to go up from the first floor to the second floor, choose products, carry them down to the first floor, and then go back up again every single time, so please improve this. It said that stamp cards would be issued in September, but I didn't receive any notification even though I spent over 10,000 yen. I didn't say anything because it was too much trouble, but I think that's something the staff should properly share information about. I met my dog ​​at Pets First, and I'm currently feeding him the wet food sold at Pets First, so I can only buy it there. If there were other stores, I would buy it elsewhere, but I put up with it and keep coming here for my dog's sake. If there aren't enough staff, I would appreciate it if you could install a call bell or make some other arrangements.
In winter, the dogs shiver and have runny noses.
It has a beautiful interior, a great location, and offers wonderful encounters.
I drop by quite often 🐶 I played the guitar at Shimamura Music on the 6th floor of Seibu Shinjuku PePe 🎸 I took a video at Pets First Shinjuku 🐶 …

I had been looking for a Pomeranian to adopt, and I fell in love with this one at first sight and decided to bring him home.

There were many situations that required adjustments due to various circumstances, but they were very kind and helpful in discussing everything, which was very reassuring.

Their service was polite and attentive throughout, and I felt completely at ease entrusting them with the care of my dog.

If I have any further questions or concerns, I would definitely like to consult with them again.

(P.S.) It's been several months since we brought him home, and he's living happily and healthily.

When I entered the store, two staff members were serving one customer, letting them touch the animals, but they were having a lively conversation and seemed young and relaxed. I wasn't the one being served, so it's probably up to each individual, but I wonder why there were so many customers in the store and it was difficult to pass through with two staff members standing in the middle.
They didn't sell pet supplies, and the main focus was on selling live animals.

When I was asked, "Do you like dogs?" I replied, "I like miniature schnauzers," to which they replied, "We don't have any miniature schnauzers. We only have cute dogs!" I was speechless at such terrible customer service.
I used to go to this store to buy wet cat food because it's now closer to me, but there's never a staff member on the sales floor. When I go to ask for help, they give me a dirty look. …

I wish I got the co workers name when I was here.
